_comment: SEC-audit-005: Pinned revisions and file-level SHA-256 hashes for HuggingFace model downloads. Each entry maps a repo_id (or local model identifier) to: (1) 'revision' — a HuggingFace commit SHA to pin downloads to (use 'main' only as a placeholder during development; pin to a real SHA in production); (2) 'files' — optional dict mapping relative file paths to expected SHA-256 hex digests. When 'files' is present and non-empty, verify_model_integrity() enforces that every pinned file exists and matches its hash — a single mismatch causes a hard failure (refuses to load the model). When 'files' is absent or empty, verification soft-passes (structural checks only) and computed hashes are logged at INFO level so operators can copy them into this file. The 'qwen' key covers the locally-installed Qwen3-ASR model directory (~/.voice-typer/models/qwen-asr/).
